invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieData<T> instance via HoodieListData.eager, which should not return null.
The method always returns the result of HoodieListData.eager, which is a HoodieListData.
The input list data is passed directly and is required by the eager method.
parallelism is an int typically representing the level of parallelism; negative values are generally invalid.
The result should contain the same elements as the input list, as HoodieListData.eager(data) wraps the list as-is.
